entry.title: MessagePack-CSharp/MessagePack-CSharp - Releases - 2026-10-30
entry.content:
v4.0.0-preview.2

This is the second preview of v4.

v4 is a ground-up redesign: more than twice the performance, stronger security by default, full Native AOT support, and many new features, including support for C# 15 union types. It is feature-compatible and wire-compatible with v3, but contains breaking changes; see the v4 README and its "Migrating from v3" section before upgrading.

Unless something major comes up, the next release will be v4.0.0, after .NET 11 is released.

Please report any problems in the Issues.
